canonical_project: Wingu Africa DJI02 / TO7 Technology Park data center and carrier-neutral CLS
notes: Wingu announced in October 2021 that it partnered with TO7 Network to develop a carrier-neutral data center and cable landing station in Djibouti. TO7 states the new carrier-neutral data center is designed, developed, funded and operated by Wingu, with TO7 owning the cable landing station. Baxtel reports DJI02/TO7 Technology Park was officially inaugurated in November 2024; DataCenterMap lists JIB-1/Djibouti City 2 with 5,000 kW IT load, 2,000 sqm colocation space and 1,000 cabinets.
